step1_create.action: Generate 48-char URL-safe code, store SHA-256 hash + 8-char prefix
step1_create.returns: plaintext code (shown once), code_prefix, email, created_at

step2_deliver.method: Admin copies plaintext code from POST /mvp/invites response
step2_deliver.note: Code cannot be recovered after this step

step3_check.action: Hash input code, lookup by code_hash, check expiry/use_count

transaction: SELECT mvp_invite FOR UPDATE WHERE code_hash = sha256(invite_code)
Validate: exists, not expired, use_count < max_uses, email binding if set
SELECT app_users WHERE username OR email (duplicate check)

email_binding.behavior: If invite.email is set, RegisterRequest.email must match (case-insensitive)
email_binding.purpose: Ensures a code issued to alice@company.com cannot be used by another person
